name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (graphics/animation domain). Accurately describes the role: cycle a sprite animation while cycling the 3-variant parallax background frames. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x2a5d0 or any data address); 'frames'/'bg' are descriptive words, not IDs. No domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Generic sprite-animation player loop: renders iter_count frames of an indexed-sprite atlas over a 3-variant cycling parallax background, one BIOS tick per frame, advancing the atlas frame according to its own per-frame hold counts.
logic_summary: Loop iter (0..iter_count-1). Each iteration: memset(workspace,0,0x1F400); bg_variant_idx=(bg_variant_idx+1)%3 (advances unconditionally every frame); rle-blit data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers[bg_variant_idx] at y=0x32 into workspace (stride 0x280, key -1); blit current atlas frame_idx into workspace; blit_rectangle workspace -> VGA aperture 0xA0000 (0x140x0xC8). Then per-frame hold: hold_count = byte at (sprite_atlas + 6 + *(int*)(sprite_atlas + 8 + frame_idx*4)) (atlas-relative: [8+frame_idx*4] is the per-frame block offset, +6 within that block holds the hold count); tick++; when tick==hold_count, reset tick to 0 via XOR-with-self and frame_idx++, wrapping frame_idx to 0 (XOR-with-self) when it reaches frame_count = *(byte*)sprite_atlas (atlas[0]). Finally fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(1). Note the leading __CHK(0x34,...) stack-probe call emitted by the compiler.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cycle_sprite_anim_with_bg_frames(uint32 sprite_atlas, uint32 workspace, uint32 iter_count)

params.name: sprite_atlas
params.semantics: Pointer to the indexed-sprite atlas (FIGANI stream) blitted each frame via fd2_blit_indexed_sprite, and read for the frame layout: atlas[0] = frame_count; *(int*)(atlas + 8 + frame_idx*4) = per-frame block byte offset; (block + 6) byte = per-frame hold count. Caller passes the caster (0x10 phase) then target-class (0x18 phase) FIGANI pointer.
params.reason: Descriptive of the indexed-sprite atlas it points to; no address residue, not a generic param_N. Already the name in src; Ghidra side still param_1 (param-name sync is a Stage 2 mechanical step, the chosen name needs no change).

params.name: workspace
params.semantics: Pointer to the 128K (0x1F400) work buffer; cleared (memset) and recomposited each frame (BG + sprite) before being pushed to the VGA aperture. Caller allocates it once with malloc(0x1F400).
params.reason: Accurately names the per-frame compositing scratch buffer; no address residue, not param_N.

params.name: iter_count
params.semantics: Number of frames/iterations to render before returning. Caller passes 0x10 (16) for the caster phase and 0x18 (24) for the target-class phase.
params.reason: Descriptive of the loop iteration count; no address residue, not param_N.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the per-frame compositing into workspace and pushes to the VGA frame buffer at 0xA0000.
